text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Japanese Derby fast approaching, Mejiro Ardan commits to her training with newfound intensity, only to end up pushing herself to the brink of collapse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She holds an unwavering belief that, as she is now, she cannot possibly win against Sakura Chiyono O or Yaeno Muteki at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan yearns to overcome the limits of her current self in the hopes of defeating her two rivals and fulfilling her dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I steel my resolve to help Mejiro Ardan push herself as hard as possible, but without forgetting my duty as her trainer to ensure she doesn't go too far.
